summary: Telecom Argentina filed a 6-K disclosing its Oct 14, 2026 board acceptance of an offer from CPS Comunicaciones (Metrotel) to buy mobile and residential internet customer packages, plus spectrum, network core and FTTH assets in Buenos Aires. The Argentine Antitrust Tribunal approved Metrotel as purchaser under remedies tied to a prior concentration. Price is US$450 million plus VAT and taxes, payable in installments, comprising asset transfer and a guaranteed minimum under a Framework Sharing Agreement covering RAN sharing, roaming and passive co-location. Watch regulatory closing and installment funding risk.
